properties.name: youtube.api.key
properties.description: API Key for accessing YouTube Data API v3. Maps to YT_API_KEY environment variable.

properties.name: base.url
properties.description: Base URL for Google YouTube API calls. Default: https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3. Maps to BASE_URL environment variable.

properties.name: app.base-url
properties.description: Public-facing base URL of the SEODrift application. Used for OAuth2 redirect URIs and template links. Maps to APP_URL environment variable.

properties.name: app.security.oauth2.encrypt-key
properties.description: AES-GCM encryption key used to encrypt OAuth2 access/refresh tokens before persisting to the oauth2_authorized_client table. Maps to OAUTH2_ENCRYPT_KEY environment variable.

properties.name: app.security.oauth2.encrypt-salt
properties.description: Hex-encoded salt used together with app.security.oauth2.encrypt-key for AES-GCM token encryption. Must be a 16-character hex string. Maps to OAUTH2_ENCRYPT_SALT environment variable.

properties.name: spring.cache.type
properties.description: Cache provider type. Set to 'redis' in production for distributed Redis caching, or 'none' to disable caching (used during AOT cache training).

properties.name: server.tomcat.max-post-size
properties.description: Maximum size of the HTTP POST request body that Tomcat will accept, in bytes. Set to -1 to disable the limit. Used to allow large video file uploads for YouTube publishing.
